index_scope.includes: recording, worker, native SNP/index, runtime job; excludes supervisors and outer controls

audit_scope.local: shared validate_stage/evaluate_cell plus direct numeric and typed inference counts, exact own/sham arrays and hashes; no independent neural recomputation
audit_scope.root_raw: shared stage-lineage guards plus independent 4687 rows, policy bindings, 40 SNPs, 16 strict core boundaries, inputs/identity and terminal process proof
audit_scope.root_outcomes: independent raw occupancy/gold, selection/inspection/timing/task and trajectory checks across all 36 conditions

limitations: Four new development cells only; 32 of 48 comparisons completed, remaining 16 matrix cells and held-out scope open.
Fixed lower-route opportunity; only four core conditions are strict U-only, other five retain declared configuration/resources.
This chunk has two nulls, one no-event and one local lower change; null confirmations are not stale-value corrections, and false targets/inspections remain retained.
Lower changed fact observed and corrected at 358 in all nine; own/sham change goal 431 versus no-U/swapped 430, null/no-event goals 430, with no own-U timing/task benefit.
Source acquisition is explicitly privileged manual supervision; continuations are actual fixed CPU FLYNN policy.act.
No biological-learning, operator-blindness, held-out or R2-completion claim.
